story.missionBrief:
=== MISSION BRIEFING ===
Role: Temporal Integrity Specialist
Type: REPAIR

Objective: Repair 5 timeline fractures before temporal paradox occurs
Location: Temporal core chamber, Chronos Station
Threat: Timeline fractures creating causality loops
Method: Restore events in chronological order, prevent paradoxes
Time Constraint: 70 seconds before paradox becomes permanent

=== AVAILABLE ABILITIES ===
• Timeline Mend: Repair one temporal fracture [5 repairs available]
• Causality Scan: Reveal correct chronological repair order [Single use]
• Temporal Freeze: Stop one fracture from spreading for 15 seconds (20 seconds cooldown)

=== STAKES ===
Success: Timeline repaired, temporal flow restored
Failure: Paradox locks in, timeline permanently fractured
